Dry-side frame / stud
A retained cap blocks a 5 mm liner lift. Remove each capture.

Cap underside starts at z5; stud ends at z20.
16 lift leaves 1; 15 gives contact, no free runout.
The 20 × 3 folded-edge box is an AUTHOR envelope.

force, deposits, fixings and uplift remain unverified.
The seam underside is not this smooth edge box.
Fold/rivet/solder profile and backing still need design.
D Three interfaces before complete wet-body release
FIXED DATUM
Release the dry-side longitudinal restraint.
A solder seam is not a detachable anchor.
EVERY KEEPER
The local cap has one defined first motion.
Temporary body support must remain.
TERMINAL / TAIL
A carried flange must clear any retained aperture.
Stem clearance alone cannot earn a straight lift.
Manage incoming water and remove independent upper units first. Body length, mass, terminal and complete handling remain unknown.
Sources: Aurubis 2013 pp81/84/108; CDA10.3F. Geometric coverage and local keeper release are not structural or hydraulic acceptance.
